summary.name: Strategr
summary.one_liner: Strategr is a macOS time management app for planning a day with color-coded activities and time-boxed sessions.
use_cases: plan a daily schedule with time blocks
rearrange a day's sessions by dragging
get reminders before the next session starts
track which session is currently running
summary.what_it_does: Strategr lets you define a list of color-coded daily activities and then place them into time-boxed sessions on a time grid. You create sessions by dragging across empty time slots, and you can move session boundaries or whole sessions, with Shift and Option modifiers for shifting neighbors or copying. A current-time marker shows the active session. The app notifies you 5 minutes before and at the start of a session, and the time grid can be adjusted in settings.
notable: Drag-based session scheduling with Shift to shift adjacent sessions and Option to copy a session
Notifications 5 minutes before and at the start of each session
Keyboard shortcuts such as Cmd+Shift+A for activities and Cmd+/ to jump to current time
caveats: Notifications depend on operating system notification settings and are on by default
Pricing and license are not stated on the page
